traits.perianth.note: APweb Commelinales page (read 2026-10-16): Commelinaceae with calyx and corolla; Pontederiaceae, Haemodoraceae and Hanguanaceae with tepals. Commelinaceae hold about 730 of the order's roughly 810 species, so the monocot value (tepals) is wrong by species weight here.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence terminal in Hanguanaceae, Pontederiaceae and Haemodoraceae; Commelinaceae cymes often leaf-opposed (terminal in origin), some also axillary.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): flowers bisexual through most of the order, andromonoecy common in Commelinaceae; Hanguanaceae dioecious.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): superior in Hanguanaceae and Commelinaceae; at least partly inferior only in Haemodoraceae-Conostylidoideae.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): no floral cup described for any family; tepals free to partly joined.

traits.life_span.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): Hanguanaceae robust perennials, Commelinaceae perennial (some annual), Haemodoraceae rhizomatous or cormous perennials; Philydraceae (inherits) are perennial marsh herbs.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): Commelinaceae, Hanguanaceae and Pontederiaceae spiral; Philydraceae and Haemodoraceae two-ranked. 'Usually' by Commelinaceae's species weight.
